Round 272 is planned: SYS-6 STATUS-LIFETIME, stage 1. The decision is **CONTINUE**.

**Round 271 result.** C passed all 19 rows on both viewports, with `browserVerified` and `realVerified` true. The gate published it as `66b570a`. On that evidence I closed:
- F1-ABSOLUTE-SNAP;
- R49-T part (1);
- SABA-B-11c;
- the whole SABA-B-9-10-11-TRANSPORT-GRID entry, whose stages all have a C PASS and are published.

The round-271 task is copied to `tasks/round-271.md` and is identical to the original.

**Gate-271 findings:**
- **Medium GATE271-S1:** with Snap on, a clip that is off the grid can no longer be dragged back onto a grid line. This is Saba's product question (SABA-Q-11C-REALIGN), not a bug in round 271. It stays `awaiting_user`, and I added the reviewer's two options to `user-review/questions-11c-stage2.md`.
- **Architecture note:** recorded as signal GATE271-ARCH-RESOLVE-MOVE-SNAP (keep for now).
- **Six new Lows** went to `deferred_low_polish`, which now holds 461. They are four test-gap findings, C-R271-01 (the arrow nudge leaves the previous status text) and B-R272-STOPPED-TEXT-WHILE-PLAYING (found during planning).

**What round 272 fixes.** Three deferred Lows share one cause. A status text that names the insert marker is never updated when the marker moves. And the "Stopped — Space plays from…" text never checks where Space will actually start. I reproduced all three in the browser at HEAD on both viewports, plus a fourth case where the marker is moved while stopped:

| Case | Text after Stop | What Space actually does |
|---|---|---|
| Marker past the end (17.000) | "plays from 00:17.000" | refuses to play |
| Marker at the end (16.000) | "plays from 00:16.000" | plays from 0 |
| Marker moved with Ctrl+←/→ | "Insert marker at 00:04.000 — playback continues" stays | plays from the new position |

**What A builds:**
- a pure module `app/lib/arrangement/playback-start.ts` that holds the existing "can Space play here?" check, extracted without change;
- a rule in the one function that writes the marker, so any text naming it is updated;
- a stop rule that writes the same text Space would act on;
- two new status strings;
- the SYS-6 matrix test (LT1–LT11), plus unit rows (PB1–PB8).

Where Space plays does not change. The file grants are exact, and the protected auth and purchase files are untouched.

**Pre-check.** I applied a sketch of the change to a scratch copy of HEAD. The full test suite gave 3252 of 3253; the only failure is a strings test that needs the two new strings added, which A is allowed to do. In the browser, the sketch fixed all five cases on both viewports with 0 page errors. One case, the past-end text updating after Home, I did not check in the browser; C has a row for it.

**Corrections after the final advisor review:**
- `sketch.diff` had been saved from the first draft. I re-exported it from the final sketch and kept the old one as `sketch-1.diff`.
- One tagged claim expected 4 matching files; the real count is 6, now corrected.
- A pre-existing gap is ruled out of this round: "Stopped — …" stays on screen after playback starts. It is scheduled for stage 2.

**Order:**
1. Round 272: SYS-6 stage 1.
2. Round 273: SYS-6 stage 2. It covers C-R271-01, the stopped text during playback, GATE270-S2 (after first checking its premise), and the INFO-C248 regression row.
3. SYS-5, then STUDIO-PERFORMANCE.

The regression round goes first on or after 2026-11-02, and the RETRO is at round 275. SABA-B-9/10/11 was a feature boundary, so I wrote a non-blocking architecture checkpoint addendum for root.

**Not COMPLETE:** SYS-6, SYS-5, STUDIO-PERFORMANCE, SYS-1..3, STORE-2b..5, REVIEW-RECOMMENDATIONS, T12-ADVANCED, the phase-2 entries and the 461 deferred Lows remain. **Not BLOCKED:** nothing external is missing. The advisor was available and I consulted it twice. The store tree is unchanged (`66b570a`, clean).
